passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations (MD&A) should be read in conjunction with the consolidated and combined financial statements included in Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data contained herein. EXECUTIVE OVERVIEW Market conditions In 2025, g lobal oil and natural gas markets remained impacted by non-OPEC supply growth, slower demand recovery in certain areas around the globe, OPEC+ production, ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, and the continued impacts of the Russia-Ukraine conflict. In the U.S., oil and natural gas production in 2025 remained elevated, despite a generally declining rig count, as a result of the industry's focus on efficiencies and higher service intensity. Lower commodity pricing and U.S. land rig counts generally contributed to softness in the market for energy products and services in North America. The international rig count decreased compared to 2024. The West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude oil price averaged approximately $60 per barrel during the fourth quarter of 2025 and approximately $65 per barrel for the full year of 2025. The Brent crude oil price averaged approximately $64 per barrel during the fourth quarter of 2025 and approximately $69 per barrel for the full year of 2025. Trade tensions and tariffs continue to shape the demand outlook amid varying market responses. We continue to monitor and assess the impact of tariffs on goods being imported into the United States . Our global supply chain organization continuously monitors market trends and works to mitigate those and other cost increases through economies of scale in global procurement, technology modifications, and efficient sourcing practices. Globally, we continue to be impacted by extended supply chain lead times for the supply of select raw materials. Also, while we have been impacted by inflationary cost increases, primarily related to chemicals, cement, and logistics costs, we generally try to pass much of those increases on to our customers and we believe we have effective solutions to minimize their operational impact. Financial results The following graph illustrates our revenue and operating margins for each operating segment over the past three years. During 2025 , we generated total company revenue of $22.2 billion , a 3% decrease from the $22.9 billion of revenue generated in 2024 with our Completion and Production (C&P) segment revenue decreasing by 4% and our Drilling and Evaluation (D&E) segment revenue decreasing by 3% . Total company operating income was $2.3 billion , including impairments and other charges of $831 million , in 2025 , compared to $3.8 billion , including impairment and other charges of $116 million , in 2024 . Due to new tariffs imposed during 2025 by the United States, the incremental expense was approximately $89 million. Driven in large part by a decrease in the average North America rig count in 2025 as compared to 2024 , our North America revenue decreased 6% in 2025 , resulting from lower activity across multiple product service lines in U.S. Land and lower completion tool sales in the Gulf of America. Description of business and strategy Halliburton Company (Halliburton) is one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the energy industry. Its predecessor was established in 1919 and incorporated under the laws of the State of Delaware in 1924. Inspired by the past and leading into the future, what started with a single product from a single location is now a global enterprise. Our value proposition is to collaborate and engineer solutions to maximize asset value for our customers. We strive to achieve strong cash flows and returns for our shareholders by delivering technology and services that improve efficiency, increase recovery, and maximize production for our customers. Halliburton has fostered a culture of unparalleled service to the world's major, national, and independent oil and natural gas producers. With over 46,000 employees, representing 146 nationalities in more than 70 countries, we help our customers maximize asset value throughout the lifecycle of the reservoir - from locating hydrocarbons and managing geological data, to drilling and formation evaluation, well construction and completion, and optimizing production throughout the life of the asset. 2025 Highlights - Financial : Our total revenue decreased 3% in 2025 as compared to 2024 . credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow comfortably covers capital spending, leaving meaningful free cash flow after capex. This internally generated liquidity funds shareholder distributions and reduces reliance on external borrowing for routine investment. The cash conversion profile compares favourably with sector peers, supporting the modest indicative financial risk profile and providing a buffer against cyclical energy service demand swings.

Interest coverage remains solid, with operating income covering gross interest costs multiple times over. The debt stack is predominantly long-dated senior notes, and no maturities fall due in the next twelve months, so refinancing risk is deferred. This maturity profile, combined with substantial cash balances, underpins the issuer's capacity to absorb a moderate earnings downturn without liquidity strain.

key_risks.text: Revenue declined modestly as North America activity softened, and operating income fell sharply, reflecting impairments and other charges alongside margin compression. The MD&A attributes weakness to lower rig counts, pricing pressure and tariff-related costs. If these headwinds persist, cash generation could erode, narrowing the headroom that currently keeps leverage below the indicative downgrade threshold.

The debt note shows a large senior note maturing in the medium term, with the remainder extending well beyond. While near-term maturities are absent, the issuer must eventually refinance or repay this balloon. Any ratings pressure or rate increase at that point would raise funding costs. The undrawn revolver provides backup liquidity but is not a substitute for term refinancing.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Free cash flow covers a substantial portion of total debt, and the ratio sits near the sector median, indicating adequate but not exceptional debt-servicing capacity. Cash flow coverage of debt is the binding constraint in the indicative risk profile, with limited headroom before a downgrade. A moderate decline in operating cash flow would materially weaken this cushion.

Liquidity is strong, with current assets well in excess of current liabilities and a healthy cash balance. The undrawn revolver adds further flexibility. However, dividends and buybacks absorb most free cash flow, leaving little retained for debt reduction. This shareholder-return posture limits deleveraging unless earnings recover or distributions are moderated.

overall_credit_view.text: The issuer presents a modest credit profile, with leverage slightly above the sector median and cash flow coverage below it. The indicative financial risk profile is supported by solid interest coverage, a long-dated maturity profile and no near-term maturities. However, declining revenue and operating income, alongside impairments, temper the outlook. We view the credit as stable but sensitive to further energy service demand weakness.

Our forward view assumes operating conditions remain challenging, with North America activity subdued and international markets mixed. Under this base case, free cash flow should continue to cover dividends and modest buybacks, but leverage is unlikely to improve materially. A sustained earnings recovery or reduced shareholder distributions would be required to strengthen the credit profile. Conversely, a deeper downturn could pressure the indicative risk tier.

credit_strengths.text: 營運現金流足以從容覆蓋資本開支，扣除資本開支後仍留下有意義的自由現金流。此內部產生的流動性為股東分派提供資金，並減少對外部借貸的依賴以應付日常投資。現金轉換狀況與同業相比較為有利，支持溫和的指示性財務風險狀況，並為週期性能源服務需求波動提供緩衝。
利息覆蓋率維持穩健，營運收入覆蓋總利息成本達數倍。債務結構以長年期優先票據為主，未來十二個月內並無到期債務，故再融資風險得以延後。此到期結構結合充裕的現金結餘，支撐發行人吸收溫和盈利下滑而不致出現流動性壓力的能力。

key_risks.text: 收入因北美活動轉弱而溫和下降，營運收入則大幅下跌，反映減值及其他費用，以及利潤率壓縮。管理層討論與分析將弱勢歸因於鑽機數量減少、定價壓力及關稅相關成本。若此等不利因素持續，現金產生可能受侵蝕，收窄目前使槓桿低於指示性降級門檻的緩衝空間。
債務附註顯示一筆大額優先票據於中期到期，其餘則遠期才到期。雖然短期內並無到期債務，發行人最終仍須為此氣球式還款再融資或償還。屆時任何評級壓力或利率上升將推高融資成本。未提取的循環信貸提供備用流動性，但並非定期再融資的替代品。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 自由現金流覆蓋總債務的相當部分，比率接近行業中位數，顯示債務償付能力充足但非卓越。現金流對債務的覆蓋是指示性風險狀況中的約束條件，降級前緩衝空間有限。營運現金流溫和下降將顯著削弱此緩衝。
流動性強勁，流動資產遠超流動負債，現金結餘穩健。未提取的循環信貸增添進一步靈活性。然而，股息及回購吸收大部分自由現金流，留存作減債的資金甚少。此股東回報取態限制去槓桿，除非盈利復甦或分派有所節制。

overall_credit_view.text: 發行人呈現溫和的信用狀況，槓桿略高於行業中位數，現金流覆蓋則低於中位數。指示性財務風險狀況獲穩健的利息覆蓋、長年期到期結構及短期內無到期債務所支持。然而，收入及營運收入下降，加上減值，令前景受抑。我們認為該信用狀況穩定，但對能源服務需求進一步轉弱敏感。
我們的前瞻觀點假設營運環境仍具挑戰，北美活動低迷，國際市場表現參差。在此基準情境下，自由現金流應繼續覆蓋股息及溫和回購，但槓桿不大可能顯著改善。須持續盈利復甦或減少股東分派方可強化信用狀況。反之，更深的低迷可能對指示性風險級別構成壓力。
